page.overview:
Who is Ashina?

Ashina is very self-centred, regularly ordering those around her to carry out tasks for her. She was so used to death threats that when one of her fan letters containing such threat, she easily shrugged it off and asked for the next letter to be read. As an actress, she places more importance in an actor's acting ability over their appearance, resenting Tomaru when he starts monopolising production because of his good looks. She focuses on her popularity very much to the point of staging a kidnapping attempt to revitalise her dwindling public image. In her desperation for fame, she was prepared to give up her life via a suicide bombing to have herself memorialised in the media.

Ashina has long dirty blonde hair and reddish brown eyes. She wears a red sleeveless dress for her soap opera, black shorts, fingerless black gloves, red boots, and a fictitious shinobi headband.

When death threats are issued to her and her scene partner Tomaru, Teams 7 and 10 are assigned to protect them. While on set, she has Team 7 perform various tasks for her, such as reading her fan mail and getting her food. When Tomaru is kidnapped, she is instructed to deliver the ransom money, but is exposed as the one who arranged the kidnapping and arrested.
